subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 third-party GitHub Action upgrades after reviewing the credential-bearing GitHub App, registry, and OpenAI-action execution paths?
rationale: The diff changes externally maintained action code in workflows that receive secrets and publish or dispatch repository operations; this is a supply-chain acceptance decision rather than a mechanical source repair.

options.title: Verify action contracts, then merge
options.body: Review upstream release diffs for the actions used with secrets, rebase the branch, and require the refreshed workflow runs to complete cleanly before merging.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Close or defer this batch if the workflow/security owner cannot validate the upgraded action contracts together, then update the affected actions in smaller reviewed groups.

recommendation.title: Verify action contracts, then merge
recommendation.body: Review upstream release diffs for the actions used with secrets, rebase the branch, and require the refreshed workflow runs to complete cleanly before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They own acceptance of third-party workflow code that handles repository and publishing credentials.
